data.message: This is great. I'm wondering though, would it be possible to simply remove the icons (like the cave icons and team members) off the GPS screens until they've actually been discovered? We already have the beeping feature which seems pointless given that the icon is on the GPS lol. I think that this would be a great improvement to the GPS system and encourage exploration. It would also be cool if the GPS itself had to be found somewhere on the map.
